_comment: Per-role access rules. Paths are relative to a code folder foundry/<code>/; '@source' means that code's main-code paths from foundry.json; 'progress' is the code folder's progress/ directory. read_deny: blocked for read/search. write_allow: writable (everything else in the project is blocked). create_only: new files only. bash: 'developer' = allowlist (see guard.py); otherwise commands that name a forbidden path are blocked. Rules apply across every code folder in the project. Agent names may carry the plugin prefix (foundry:developer). The main session is not restricted.
